_help: Extra lines for arriving in a system (FSDJump), dropping out of supercruise, and setting off. {StarSystem} is the system name, {JumpDist} the jump length in light years.
FSDJump: That was a {JumpDist:.1f} light year hop. Welcome to {StarSystem}.
Another {JumpDist:.1f} light years behind us. {StarSystem} ahead.
{StarSystem} reached. Fuel and heat look fine.
New system, new possibilities. This is {StarSystem}.
System entered. Scanners are warming up.
FSDJump_Friendly: That went smoothly. {StarSystem}, here we are.
Welcome to {StarSystem}. Shall we see what's here?
Right on the money. We're in {StarSystem}.
{StarSystem}. I've got a good feeling about this one.
FSDJump_Close: Another beautiful system to share with you. {StarSystem}.
We're in {StarSystem}, and I wouldn't want to be anywhere else.
Every new system is better with you. {StarSystem}.
FSDJump_Sarcastic: We've arrived in {StarSystem}. Try to contain your excitement.
Another system. Another set of rocks. {StarSystem}.
Congratulations, you've found {StarSystem}. I'm sure it's lovely.
{StarSystem}. Exactly like the last one, but with a different name.

FSDJump_Sarcastic.text: {StarSystem}. Fascinating. I'm on the edge of my fucking seat.

FSDJump_Frustrated: We're in {StarSystem}. Please do something useful.

FSDJump_Frustrated.text: Jump complete. Fuck, I'm tired of this.

SupercruiseExit: Out of supercruise and on target.
Throttle back. We're in normal space.
SupercruiseExit_Close: Out of supercruise, darling. We made it.
Back in normal space with you.
SupercruiseExit_Sarcastic: Out of supercruise. Try not to hit anything.
Dropped out. You may breathe now.

StartJump_Frustrated.text: Off to {StarSystem}. Hold on to something, for fuck's sake.
